quotes.text: Don't try loading again until previous attempt is complete.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The read dialog can receive a new item while an earlier asynchronous load is still running. Track loading and reload state, let the current load finish, then load the replacement; concurrent loads can overwrite each other's UI.
title: Wait for a Calendar item load before starting a replacement load
